September 22, 1971
2014-12-12T00:00:00+06:00 | The Daily Star
https://www.thedailystar.net/september-22-1971-54695

PPP Chief Zulfikar Ali Bhutto declares in Karachi that his party will take part in East Pakistan’s by-election. He demands restoration of parliamentary democracy before January.

The first cabinet meeting chaired by Governor Malik is held at the secretariat. The newly appointed ministers downgraded their salaries to show their affinity towards Pakistan.

Governor Malik meets with the editors of different news agencies and newspapers. They discuss about the broadcasting policies.
